parameters.query:
SET search_path TO inventario;

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM productos)        AS total_productos,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ventas)           AS total_ventas,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clientes)         AS total_clientes,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entradas)         AS total_entradas,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salidas)          AS total_salidas,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alertas 
     WHERE estado = 'pendiente')            AS alertas_pendientes,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) 
     FROM ventas 
     WHERE fecha::DATE = CURRENT_DATE)      AS ventas_hoy,
    CURRENT_DATE                            AS fecha_backup;
